_doc.purpose: App-specific patterns learned across runs. The 3rd form with a mobile field reuses what runs 1-2 established instead of re-deriving it.
_doc.authority: HINT ONLY — never an oracle. The Epic AC decides expected behaviour (AH Rule 19). A pattern suggests WHICH cases to write and WHERE the element usually is.
_doc.staleness: AH Rule 30 applies. Re-verify against live DOM before use; on mismatch trust the DOM and update the pattern.

fieldPatterns.name: mobile-number
standardCases: 11 digits via pressSequentially — maxlength enforcement (BVA, AH Rule 18)

uiConventions.name: inline-field-error
uiConventions.rule: Validation errors render in a span adjacent to the field, id = <fieldName> + error suffix

flowPatterns.name: blinkit-successful-login
steps: fill first name, last name, 10-digit mobile

inconsistencies.observation: Error-element id suffix differs across pages: blinkit-login.html uses 'Err' (#mobileErr, #firstNameErr), registration-demo.html uses 'Error' (#emailError, #firstNameError)
inconsistencies.note: Naming inconsistency across the app. Raise with the team as a convention finding — do not auto-normalise, and do not file as a product bug without an AC to cite.
